segments.en:
This is the port of the Side 1
space colony...
"Londenion."

It's amazing to think there's
man-made land inside this
huge structure...
Londenion Spaceport...
Hey... You hear?

Word is the Argama
came to the colony.
Is that so...

Let's hope it doesn't
turn into trouble...
What's going on?

Wasn't the Argama's docking
supposed to be classified?
So this is the town of Londenion...

Back in Claudia where I'm from,
there are towns like this too...

Hey, kid,
got a sec?
Huh?

Uh, sure...
What is it?

You ain't a colony
resident, are ya?

Huh?
How can you tell?

Well, you were starin' up at the
ceiling like it was somethin' rare...

Hahaha...
I'm still not used to space.

I mean, isn't it strange that
there's a town up in the sky too?

Hahaha!
Just came from Earth, I take it.

But listen, kid,
you'd better watch yourself.

Lotta folks in the colonies
can't stand people who
used to live on Earth.

Huh?
Why's that?

You've gotten to your age
without knowing any of this?

Out in space, it's mostly
working-class folks.

Anyone with a home on Earth
gets taken for one of the elite.

Huh...
Is that right?

Got it?
Don't go wandering into
the back alleys much.
See ya!

People living on the ground
are the elite, huh...

Doesn't sound like life in
space is all that comfortable.

rows.notes: [jp] -> 'kid'. Civilian's gender unknown; no pronoun used for them. | [editorial 14] awkward 'You're that age and...'; natural rendering of [jp] | [editorial 15] 'Space is mostly working-class folks' reads oddly

segments.en:
Apparently this town was
once devastated by war.

It must've been rebuilt through
the hard work of a lot of people...

A colony's land is on the
inside of the cylinder.

So when it's clear out, you can
see a town up on the ceiling...

Then again, from over there,
we're the ones on the ceiling...

In the colonies, electric cars
called elecars are what
citizens use to get around.

That's so they don't pollute the
air inside the sealed colony.

Well, it makes sense
when you think about it.

Anyway, it just shows how strictly
the air is managed in space.
No useful information, huh...
Let's try somewhere else.
The town of Londenion...

Yo! Kanji,
find out anything?
Let's see...

Oh, right...
A civilian I met outside knew
about the Argama docking.

Well, if they work for the Colony
Corporation, that's not so strange.

Didn't seem that way
to me, though...

So basically, ordinary citizens
are keeping that close an eye on
military comings and goings, right?

Peace is being kept,
more or less...

but there's been fighting here
and there these past few years.

So even civilians are
on a war footing, huh...
That's about the size of it.
Well then...

I've had my break.
Guess I'll head back to the port...

rows.notes: Civilian kept gender-neutral ('they'). [jp] = Colony Corporation (glossary NPC labels).

segments.en:
This is the lounge
next to the spaceport...
Maybe I'll rest here a bit...

Looks like there's nobody
in the lounge...
Guess I'll go somewhere else...

The spaceport is zero-G, but
this lounge has a little gravity.

I wonder if that's to help people
adjust to the change in gravity...?

rows.notes: [editorial 1] clarity: 'the change' had no referent on this page (accuracy flag); 'gravity' restored from [jp]

segments.en:
I tried sitting on the sofa,
but it doesn't quite feel
like I'm really sitting...

I'd better hurry up and get
used to life in space, too...

The lounge at
Londenion's port...

Hmm...
So it's this wide open outside town.

Standing here, it doesn't feel
like man-made land at all...

rows.notes: [editorial 0] awkward 'it's this wide outside the town'

segments.en:
Hey!
Kanji, what's up?

Hm?
Oh...

The view here is
pretty, isn't it?

This colony was rebuilt as a
resort colony after the One Year War.

Huh~
No wonder there are so many plants.

I hear Side 1 got
hit pretty hard...

Supposedly it took nearly
ten years to rebuild.
I see...

See ya.
Don't stay out too late.
I know.

Now then, where
should I go next?

From here, the horizon looks
like it curves the other way.

Since the land is the inside of
the cylinder, that's only natural.
Hmm...

They say colonies make gravity
with centrifugal force, but
I can't really feel it...
Forget it...

If I think about it too hard,
I'll get dizzy.
The outskirts of Londenion...

This place is beautiful no matter
how many times I come here...

rows.notes: [editorial 1] flow: 'No matter how many times I come, it's a beautiful place' was stilted

segments.en:
It's pretty quiet
out this way...
Now then, where should I go next?
The outskirts of Londenion...
